Secondary: pillar page hub-spoke topic cluster — central pillar node with 5 cluster pages connected bidirectionally
Tertiary: in-article contextual link mockup — blurred paragraph with one blue internal anchor link underline highlighted
anti_patterns: LLM chat panel as hero (this is internal linking SEO not GEO)
External/outbound link diagram as primary visual
Generic sitemap XML without internal link arrows
